description: Direct-reference ablation for the 27 GeoMind VLA tasks. Scene, object poses, intervention scripts and seeds are identical to the base task; only the instruction text and the GT target appearance (recolor) or an added visual-only marker change.

gradient_tiers.unchanged: mechanism=none: nothing changes at all. Sanity anchor: base and direct must score identically.
gradient_tiers.instruction_only: mechanism=recolor but the GT target is already the unique green object, so the applied color is a no-op. Only the instruction text differs.
gradient_tiers.instruction_plus_recolor: mechanism=recolor with a real appearance change on the GT target.
gradient_tiers.instruction_plus_marker: mechanism=marker: a visual-only green/magenta disc is added at the GT goal point.
